headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins in a thrilling 1-0 victory. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 win over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers in two separate games.

The Toronto Blue Jays placed Vladimir Guerrero Jr. on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Other notable injuries include Abner Uribe of the Milwaukee Brewers, Colt Emerson of the Seattle Mariners, Davis Martin of the Chicago White Sox, Matt Chapman of the San Francisco Giants, Trevor McDonald of the San Francisco Giants, Garrett Whitlock of the Boston Red Sox, and James Outman of the Detroit Tigers.

The Athletics traded SS Jonathan Ornelas to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash, while the Boston Red Sox traded CF Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles as part of the Adley Rutschman trade. The Miami Marlins traded 1B Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, marking their final score. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a strong 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a crucial double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Randal Grichuk, Andrew Benintendi, Tristan Peters, and Eduardo Valencia all had notable performances in the game.

top_news.title: **Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Athletics Make Roster Move Ahead of Deadline**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics traded shortstop Jonathan Ornelas to the Milwaukee Brewers in exchange for cash.
